groups.name: Europen Cluster 1
groups.tagline: 9 Nights, 10 Days · France, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Belgium

offer.summary: 10 days trip built around France, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Belgium at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Europe journeys we shape by hand through Europe, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Experience Parisian icons, elegant boulevards, riverside charm and the timeless beauty of the French countryside.
Soak in majestic Alpine scenery, serene lakes, charming old towns and the dramatic Rhine Falls.
Wander through the enchanting Old City, grand palaces and panoramic valleys of this small European gem.
Discover Brussels' Grand Place, Bruges' romantic canals and the country's irresistible chocolates, waffles and medieval charm.

Experience Vienna's imperial elegance, Salzburg's musical heritage and the breathtaking Austrian Alps.
Cruise Amsterdam's storybook canals and explore charming villages, windmills and colourful Dutch landscapes.
Enjoy the peaceful Alpine charm of Vaduz, with its hilltop castle, mountain villages and sweeping valley views.

highlights: Experience Madrid's grand avenues, Seville's flamenco spirit, Granada's Alhambra and Barcelona's striking Gaudí architecture.
Discover Lisbon's tiled streets, Sintra's fairytale palaces, Porto's riverside charm and the Algarve's dramatic golden coast.

Experience Budapest's grand Parliament, Buda Castle and soothing thermal baths along the beautiful Danube.
Explore Kraków's historic centre, Warsaw's resilient heritage and remarkable landmarks such as Malbork Castle and Wieliczka Salt Mine.

groups.name: Italy
groups.tagline: 13 Nights, 14 Days · Milan, Venice, Florence, Rome, Sorrento, Sicily, Vatican City

offer.summary: 14 days trip built around Milan, Venice, Florence, Rome, Sorrento, Sicily, Vatican City at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Europe journeys we shape by hand through Europe, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Admire the magnificent Duomo, explore elegant Brera and experience Italy's capital of fashion and design.
Glide through timeless canals, wander across picturesque bridges and discover the romance of St. Mark's Square.
Immerse yourself in Renaissance beauty at the Duomo, Uffizi Gallery, Ponte Vecchio and Michelangelo's David.
Walk through the living history of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Trevi Fountain.
Step into the spiritual and artistic heart of the world at the Vatican City, where masterpieces like the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica await.
Relax amid lemon-scented streets, dramatic coastal views and easy access to the Amalfi Coast, Capri and Pompeii.
Discover a captivating island of ancient ruins, volcanic landscapes, sunlit coastlines and unforgettable Mediterranean flavours.

groups.name: Greece
groups.tagline: 9 Nights, 10 Days · Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Crete-Heraklion

offer.summary: 10 days trip built around Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Crete-Heraklion at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Europe journeys we shape by hand through Europe, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for minimum 4 PAX travelling together
highlights: Stand among the timeless ruins of the Acropolis, Parthenon and Ancient Agora in the cradle of Western civilisation.
Wander through whitewashed lanes, iconic windmills and Little Venice before relaxing on its sunlit beaches.
Soak in breathtaking caldera views from the cliffside villages of Oia and Fira, especially at sunset.
Step into Minoan history at the Palace of Knossos and explore the world's finest collection of Minoan art at Heraklion Archaeological Museum.

highlights: Discover Copenhagen's royal charm, colourful Nyhavn waterfront, historic castles and effortlessly elegant city life.
Cruise through majestic fjords, dramatic mountain valleys and peaceful coastal villages shaped by Arctic beauty.
Experience Stockholm's graceful archipelago, royal heritage, waterfront streets and rich maritime history.
Embrace Helsinki's clean Nordic design, tranquil forests, thousands of lakes and serene sauna culture.
Journey through volcanic landscapes, glaciers, waterfalls and geothermal lagoons beneath unforgettable northern skies.

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Manchester, London, Liverpool at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Europe journeys we shape by hand through Europe, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Explore the vibrant cultural scene and iconic landmarks in Manchester, including the National Football Museum and the Museum of Science and Industry.
Discover London's world-famous attractions, such as the London Eye, Lake District, Madame Tussauds, and take a scenic Thames River cruise.
Visit the historic port city of Liverpool, famous for its rich maritime heritage and being the home of the Beatles.

groups.name: Scotland
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Glasgow, Edinburg, Inverness, Stirling, Aberdeen, Dundee

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Glasgow, Edinburg, Inverness, Stirling, Aberdeen, Dundee at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Europe journeys we shape by hand through Europe, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Experience Glasgow's legendary music scene and stunning Victorian architecture, from the Kelvingrove Art Gallery to the vibrant West End.
Walk the historic Royal Mile in Edinburgh, exploring the majestic Edinburgh Castle and the atmospheric narrow closes of the Old Town.
Gateway to the Highlands, Inverness offers a chance to search for Nessie at Loch Ness and visit the historic Culloden Battlefield.
Step back in time at Stirling Castle, one of Scotland's most important historic sites, and take in the views from the Wallace Monument.
Discover the "Granite City" of Aberdeen, where sparkling stone architecture meets a bustling harbor and beautiful sandy coastlines.
Visit Dundee's innovative waterfront, home to the striking V&A Dundee design museum and the historic RRS Discovery.

groups.name: Ireland
groups.tagline: 8 Nights, 9 Days · Dublin, Galway, Clonmacnoise, Cork, Limerick, Kilkenny

highlights: Where literary legends, Guinness heritage, and Temple Bar's cobbled charm converge along the River Liffey.
A bohemian coastal gem bursting with street music, colorful shopfronts, and gateway access to the wild beauty of Connemara and the Aran Islands.
A serene monastic sanctuary on the Shannon, where ancient high crosses and cathedral ruins whisper tales of early Irish Christianity.
Ireland's culinary capital, where vibrant markets, historic English Market, and nearby coastal villages like Kinsale blend food, culture, and sea views.
Home to the mighty King John's Castle on the Shannon, medieval lanes, and the poetic legacy of the Treaty Stone.
A medieval jewel crowned by its imposing castle, cobbled lanes, craft breweries, and Ireland's finest preserved Norman heritage.
